findings.title: Pipeline value concentrated in one stage
findings.body: Of the total pipeline_value_usd of $134,541,500, the Negotiating PSA stage alone accounts for $95,075,000 across 5 records — roughly two-thirds of all tracked value sitting in a single funnel stage. If any of these 5 deals stalls or falls through, the pipeline value drops sharply.
findings.action: Review the 5 Negotiating PSA deals individually this week to confirm none are at risk of slipping.

findings.title: Food vertical deals missing broker and property type
findings.body: Six of the ten data-gap entries are Food vertical deals missing 'broker' and/or 'property_type' fields, with completeness scores as low as 67% (201 N Miami Ave) and 73% (2733 W Harrison St, 37 S Hudson St, 250001 Km 3 via chia cajica). This is worth checking since Food is the largest vertical by pipeline value at $100,115,000.
findings.action: Assign someone to backfill broker and property_type fields for the 6 flagged Food deals before the meeting.

findings.title: Negotiated prices came in below list on all 3 tracked deals
findings.body: The three deals with negotiated-vs-list data all closed negotiations below asking: 2733 W Harrison St at -6.15%, 5861 Washington Blvd at -9.77%, and 9213 183rd St at -3.77%. This is only 3 records, but it's worth checking whether this negotiation leverage pattern holds as more deals get tracked.
findings.action: Have the deal team document negotiation tactics used on these 3 deals to potentially replicate on active PSA/LOI deals.

findings.title: 9213 183rd St has been on market 423 days
findings.body: 9213 183rd St shows days_on_market of 423 while still in Negotiating LOI stage, and it's also missing the 'client' field (completeness 91%). A listing open this long is worth checking to understand what's holding up progression to LOI/PSA.
findings.action: Get a status update from the deal lead on 9213 183rd St this week and confirm the client field.

findings.title: Two deals show price-per-SF far above the pipeline median
findings.body: 250001 Km 3 via chia cajica shows price_per_sf of 1725 and 5861 Washington Blvd shows 1139, versus a pipeline median of 261.9 (range 116.07–1725 across 11 records). Both are flagged by the pipeline as 'kept as-is (looks real)', but the size of the gap is worth checking manually before quoting these figures externally.
findings.action: Have an analyst independently verify the bldg_sf/price inputs behind these two price_per_sf figures.

739191ab76a2d25c.headline: Two-thirds of pipeline value ($95,075,000 of $134,541,500) sits in Negotiating PSA, and several Food deals are missing broker/property_type data — both worth checking before Monday.

findings.title: Negotiating PSA holds largest share of pipeline value
findings.body: The Negotiating PSA stage has 4 records and 4 sites worth $26,075,000, the highest value_usd of any stage in the funnel. This is where the most capital is concentrated and closest to closing.
findings.action: Review the 4 Negotiating PSA deals individually this week to confirm nothing is stalling before contract.

findings.title: 201 N Miami Ave missing core deal fields at 67% complete
findings.body: 201 N Miami Ave (Food, In Pipeline) is missing bldg_sf, list_price, and property_type, with only 67.0% completeness — the lowest in the dataset. Without list_price the deal cannot be properly valued or compared.
findings.action: Have the deal owner backfill bldg_sf, list_price, and property_type for 201 N Miami Ave before it advances stages.
evidence: 201 N Miami Ave: missing bldg_sf, list_price, property_type; completeness_pct 67.0

findings.title: 9213 183rd St has sat 423 days with data unconfirmed
findings.body: 9213 183rd St has been on market 423 days per the outliers flag, is missing the 'client' field (completeness 91.0%), and its negotiated price of $5,750,000 (vs list $5,975,000, delta -3.77%) is listed as an unconfirmed value extracted from free-text notes. This combination is worth checking before committing further resources.
findings.action: Verify the current_price and client fields for 9213 183rd St directly with the broker before the next LOI step.

findings.title: 5861 Washington Blvd price/sf of 1139 is worth checking
findings.body: 5861 Washington Blvd shows a price_per_sf of 1139, far above the dataset median of 259.74 (max 1139 among 10 priced records), and is flagged as an outlier though noted as 'looks real.' It also has a negotiated price of $3,000,000 vs list $3,325,000 (-9.77%), an unconfirmed value from free-text extraction.
findings.action: Confirm the underlying square footage and price figures for 5861 Washington Blvd with the source document before relying on this comp.

findings.title: Airline Catering deals repeatedly missing client field
findings.body: Four Airline Catering deals — 9213 183rd St, 85 Channel Dr, 648 Main St, and Westbury (no address) — are all missing the 'client' field, with completeness ranging 78.0% to 91.0%. This is a repeated gap in one vertical, not a one-off.
findings.action: Assign one team member to close the 'client' field gap across all four Airline Catering records this week.
evidence: 9213 183rd St, 85 Channel Dr, 648 Main St, Westbury (no address): missing_fields client

f2a815f64ae8b195.headline: The $26,075,000 sitting in Negotiating PSA is the week's priority, but data gaps on 201 N Miami Ave (67.0% complete) and an unverified 1139 price/sf on 5861 Washington Blvd need checking before any of it is presented as solid.
